text:
lena: quick design ping 1 — deciding where the invoice download UX should surface on the Usage page. two patterns in figma: modal chooser vs single-click top-level download. thoughts?
omar: link: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_INVOICE_FLOW
frank: Modal chooser idea: click "Invoice" → modal with radio: [Official PDF (signed)] [CSV export (tokens)] [Include token breakdown]. Pros: explicit options, legal-friendly. Cons: extra click for power users.
pm_liu: Legal prefers an obvious "Official PDF" path. If we do modal, default selection should be Official PDF and include microcopy: "Official invoice (PDF) — suitable for accounting records." No objections.
lena: Single-click idea: top-right download icon that immediately downloads the most appropriate artifact based on scope (Org → PDF, Project → CSV). Faster but opaque.
frank: Concern: single-click could confuse users who expect CSV. Maybe add a tiny caret to give quick access to chooser: [Download ▼] where primary action is default but dropdown exposes other formats.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: if we use a modal it must trap focus and return focus on close. Radio buttons need labels and default announced. If we use a dropdown, ensure each item is reachable by keyboard and has clear aria-labels like "Download official invoice PDF for Organization".
omar: Chart/layout bit: current mocks show a stacked card view for projects (compact cards with sparkline). Alternative is table rows. Cards give room for an inline invoice badge/button; table is denser. Which should govern where we put per-project invoice affordances?
pm_liu: For auditor workflows, customers want a per-project "official" mark next to invoices. We could surface a small badge "Official" on rows/cards where a PDF is available.
lena: Implementation note from frank: generating many PDFs at once may be expensive. We should support an async bulk request that returns an email link when ready for very large orgs. For small selections (<10) do immediate in-browser download.
frank: backend note: will add queue job + signed S3 links for generated archives. ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket INF-2044 for async invoice batch job.
a11y-bot: Also require aria-live region to announce "Invoice generation started. You will be notified when ready." for async flows. And include progress in notifications.
omar: UX compromise: make the top-level control a split-button: primary click downloads default (PDF for org, CSV for project), caret opens modal/dropdown for other formats and a "Generate all" option that triggers async job with confirmation.
lena: mobile: split-button collapses to single button that opens modal chooser to keep discovery consistent.
pm_liu: microcopy settled: primary label "Download invoice"; modal header "Choose invoice format"; async confirmation text "Generating invoices. We'll email you when ready." Legal ok.
frank: dev estimates: frontend 3d for split-button + modal + keyboard flow. backend 2d for batch job + signed links. I'll open PRs after figma update.
lena: action items: omar update figma with split-button + card/table variants; frank link backend ticket; a11y-bot produce acceptance checklist (focus trap, aria-live, labels); pm_liu confirm final copy in design spec. I'll mark design-ready once figma + tickets linked. :white_check_mark:
